attchmntText: Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Post- Issue Advertisement for the Rights Issue of Indiabulls Ventures Limited has been published in the newspaper'.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Grant of 1550000  Options.

Sameer Gehlaut , Orthia Properties Private Limited ,Orthia Constructions Private Limited and Zelkova Builders Private Limited has submitted to the Exchange a Copy of pursuant to Regulation 10(6) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 ("SEBI SAST Regulations"), in the prescribed format in respect of the acquisition of Equity Shares pursuant to Rights Issue of Indiabulls Ventures Limited.

Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange that the Designated Stock Exchange for the purpose of the Rights Issue, has on March 15, 2018, approved the basis of allotment, pursuant to which the Securities Issuance Committee (��Committee��) in its meeting held on March 16, 2018, has approved the allotment of 82,948,313 Partly paid up Equity Shares of the Company, of face value of Rs. 2 each at a price of Rs. 240 per Equity Share (including a premium of Rs. 238 per Equity Share), on rights basis, to the eligible applicants, who have subscribed in the Rights Issue. The Company has received an amount of Rs. 60 per Partly paid up Equity Share (including a premium of Rs. 59.50 per Equity Share).

Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Pre-Issue Advertisement- Issue of upto 83,333,333 partly paid up equity shares of face value of Rs. 2 each of Indiabulls Ventures Limited ("Company") for cash at a price of Rs. 240 (including a premium of Rs. 238) per equity share ("Rights Equity Shares") for an amount aggregating up to Rs. 20,000 million on a right basis to the Eligible Equity Shareholders of the Company in the ratio of 3 Rights Equity Shares for every 16 fully paid-up equity shares held by such Eligible Equity Shareholders on the Record Date, i.e. on February 12, 2018 (the "Rights Issue").

Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Filing of Letter of Offer- Issue of upto 83,333,333 partly paid up equity shares of face value of Rs. 2 each of Indiabulls Ventures Limited (��Company��) for cash at a price of Rs. 240 (including a premium of Rs. 238) per equity share (��Rights Equity Shares��) for an amount aggregating up to Rs. 20,000 million on a rights basis to the Eligible Equity Shareholders of the Company in the ratio of 3 Rights Equity Shares for every 16 fully paid-up equity shares held by such Eligible Equity Shareholders on the Record Date, i.e. on February 12, 2018 (the ��Issue��).'.

Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange that This is further to the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on September 21, 2017 approving the issuance of equity and equity linked instruments including equity shares of face value of Rs. 2 each of the Company by way of a rights issue to the existing shareholders of the Company as on the record date for an amount not exceeding Rs. 3,000 crore in accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2009, as amended and other applicable laws (the ��Rights Issue��); Company's letter dated January 25, 2018 providing a prior intimation under Regulation 29 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, for the meeting of the Committee to determine, amongst others, the issue price of Equity Shares in the Rights Issue; the outcome of the meeting to determine, amongst others, the issue price, submitted to the stock exchanges on January 31, 2018; and the outcome of a subsequent meeting of the Committee on January 31, 2018 to determine the record date for the Rights Issue.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as February 12, 2018 for the purpose of Right Issue

Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange that the Committee, at its meeting held on January 31, 2018, has approved the the Rights Equity Shares are being offered on a rights basis to the Eligible Equity Shareholders in the ratio of 3 Rights Equity Shares for every 16 Equity Shares held on the Record Date.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on January 31, 2018.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Committee Meeting to be held on January 31, 2018.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Earnings Update for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2017'.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2017.

Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'newspaper clippings of the Notice to Shareholders regarding Compulsory Transfer of Equity Shares of the Company to DEMAT Account of the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority'.
Indiabulls Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investor Presentation
